root_idea.summary: The root centers on casting or releasing something in separated, dispersed pieces.
root_idea.development: Its lexical range develops from scattering objects to describing scattered results, progressive dispersion, expulsion of matter from the nose, and specialized anatomical and figurative uses. Some extensions, such as the name for armor, are reported as possibly irregular.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested Form VIII verb with an independently supported dispersal meaning.
Quran-attested passive participle with a lexically supported meaning of being scattered or strewn.

senses.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form VIII; the Quranic occurrence describes the stars becoming dispersed.

senses.definition: Scattered, strewn, dispersed, or thrown about.
senses.usage_conditions: Passive participle describing something presented in a dispersed arrangement or state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To scatter, sprinkle, strew, disperse, or throw something about in separated portions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I verb, commonly describing the scattering of grain, fruit, dates, nuts, sugar, pearls, or similar objects, often by hand; also used of a palm shedding its unripe dates and of matter being scattered from the body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To scatter abundantly, repeatedly, or over many objects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive or causative extension of scattering; the evidence associates it with muchness, repetition, or application to numerous things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have many children; of a woman, to bring forth numerous children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use referring to abundant offspring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To talk much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or tropical use of the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten or be quick in reading or recitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use referring to the manner of reading or reciting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sneeze, blow the nose, or expel mucus and other irritating matter through the nose.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used in ablution contexts for expelling what is in the nose after water has been taken into it; the sources distinguish this nasal expulsion from merely drawing in water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend with another in scattering, strewing, or dispersing something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form III construction involving two parties and a scattering action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold a disputation or colloquy with another in elegant or beautiful language.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression developed from the image of scattering pearls or other valued things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone’s nose bleed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV use, commonly after piercing or striking someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To throw someone down upon the end of the nose or the nose.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive construction describing the result of piercing or striking a mounted person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become scattered progressively, piece by piece, or in repeated dispersion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Related derived patterns are described as conveying gradual or part-by-part scattering, and in intensive uses the repeated scattering of many things; the same imagery is applied to hair or leaves falling apart and to people becoming separated, including by successive deaths.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Prose; also rhyming prose, contrasted with metrical composition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is explained by comparison with scattered pearls or grain, in contrast to ordered verse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Loquacity and the divulging of secrets.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal use associated with excessive or indiscreet speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Loquacious; one who talks much, sometimes vainly or frivolously, or divulges secrets.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a person characterized by such speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single act of scattering, strewing, dispersing, or throwing something about.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal action noun for one instance of the scattering action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sneeze, especially an animal’s sneeze or expulsion from the nose.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may describe the expulsion of irritating matter through an animal’s nose; a reported expression calls locusts the sneeze of a fish.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The end or tip of the nose, the space between the nostrils, or the nose and adjacent region.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun, with some descriptions extending it to the lion’s nose.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An asterism or lunar mansion identified with the nose of the lion; in astronomical descriptions, a group of stars associated with a hazy patch.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A traditional astronomical use of the anatomical image of the nose.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Armor when it is worn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use reported as a possible irregular extension of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What becomes scattered from a thing, especially crumbs, fragments, or scattered table remains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May refer to scattered grain and similar material, or to crumbs lying around a table.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of scattering, strewing, or dispersing, especially fruit, nuts, sugar, grain, or money.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also denotes participation in a customary scattering of such items, for example at a festive occasion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What has been scattered, strewn, or thrown about.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use equivalent to a passive participle and referring to scattered fruit, sugar, or similar objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman or man having numerous offspring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive noun for prolific parenthood; the evidence also records a feminine animal application in a separate sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ewe or she-goat with a wide teat orifice, as though scattering milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-husbandry term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree that shakes off or sheds its unripe dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a palm whose unripe dates become scattered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sheep or goat that coughs or sneezes and ejects material from its nose.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expelled material may be described as resembling worms or as something irritating or harmful.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Scattered or abundantly strewn, especially of pearls.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive passive-participial description of pearls scattered in quantity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having numerous young children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression likening numerous children to scattered contents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of sweet-smelling flower.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized botanical noun distinct from the ordinary passive-participial sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a scattered, strewn, or dispersed state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participial description applicable to one thing or to multiple things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw water into the nose and then expel it through the nose.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X ablution practice involving nasal rinsing and expulsion.
